prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. One single high-resolution transparent game running sprite, square full canvas at least 1024px.
Image 1 is the exact current thunder caster boy edit target and identity. Image 2 is the user-approved same-direction archer only for readable support-versus-swing mechanics, not for copying her proportions or costume. Image 3 is approved painted style.
Preserve the entire upper body, exact head size and canvas position, hair margins, camera, head angle, torso, cape, shoulder/elbow swing, hands and props from image 1. Anatomical RIGHT hand keeps golden pointed scepter, LEFT hand keeps rectangular gold taiji plaque. Do not zoom, resize, move whole character, change the arms, rotate camera or copy another pose.
The user needs a continuous real contact progression: one foot contacts, remains grounded while the body passes over it, pushes behind, then the other foot lands. This is a distinct single frame in that progression. Redraw actual hip/knee/ankle/boot geometry below the robe to achieve the described support location, not by shifting the whole image. Keep short chibi legs, subtle knee compression, knee-ankle-toe aligned with travel direction, no sideways splay. Only the support foot touches its invisible ground plane. Opposite swinging foot stays distinctly raised. Both legs remain readable. Coordinates are composition guides on a 1024 square, scaled proportionately for larger canvas.
NORTH straight rear view. LATE REAR SUPPORT / PUSH-OFF phase. The LEFT, screen LEFT leg is STILL the same support leg, extended BEHIND pelvis toward viewer, its FOREFOOT/toe tip in ground contact near (457,977). Heel raises gradually toward camera, visible narrow dark outsole and gold sole rim, boot long axis still NORTH, no outward turn. Knee extends naturally to push the body forward; short wrapped calf, no long straight tube. The other RIGHT, screen RIGHT leg swings FORWARD with bent knee and boot lifted clearly above the ground, approaching next touchdown but not bearing weight. This is essential: do not let the other leg become support yet, and do not draw both feet airborne. Start the push with low heel lift and toe loaded.
Retain clean detailed hand-painted ivory/navy/gold fabric, gold fittings, turquoise beads, white calf wraps and black/gold boots. Exactly two legs and feet. Real alpha transparency; no floor, shadow patch, dust, glow, effects, arrows or labels. No mirroring, duplicate-pose shortcut, limb stretching, extra boots, or whole-sprite translation. Return one complete sprite only.
